store.0: Patient with Type 2 Diabetes on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Recently added semaglutide(Ozempic) at low dose for better blood sugar control and appetite management. Fasting blood sugar typically between 125-130 mg/dL.

Uses meloxicam 7.5 mg when joints are particularly stiff(knees and hands), but only intermittently due to concern about NSAID overuse. Doctor suggested glucosamine supplements; effect on symptoms is unclear and not yet confirmed. Also adjusted vitamin D intake: now takes vitamin D3 2,000 IU daily after low levels(22 ng/mL) on blood test(normal >30 ng/mL). Takes calcium supplements due to early osteopenia on bone density scan. Doctor recommends combining with vitamin K2 to improve absorption.
